messages:
Lena (AE): FYI Synthex submitted an onboarding for a maintenance-log pipeline. Asking for private deployment + HSM-backed keys + mandatory PHI scrub. Go-live target 2025-07-01. They flagged renewal as contingent on compliance.
Marco (CS): copy. do we have traffic numbers and sample redaction examples? also any hard latency SLOs?
Lena (AE): traffic: baseline 20 req/s, burst to 100 req/s for nightly backfills. samples attached in ticket (they labeled ~300 lines). SLOs: p95 end-to-end <300ms. exec says no exceptions.
Diego (Solutions): initial design: 6B summarizer + 2B reranker in-series, redaction step prior to summarizer. private VPC + dedicated pool. propose canary in their staging VPC. need to confirm allowed model list (they prefer OSS checkpoints).
Asha (Runtime): runtime notes: 6B + 2B in-series increases mem/KV pressure. for steady 20rps + 100 peak we recommend 3 A100 workers (or 6 x T4 with sharding). need token-length distribution — long logs could blow past KV limits. also suggest prefix caching if logs repeat.
Priya (Security): security flags: HSM integration path (bring-your-own vs our managed) + per-request audit log retention (90d) + strict no-raw-egress policy. PHI redaction must have auditability (store original only in secure bucket accessible to customer). Also we need to run a privacy review and sign a dataplane addendum.

onboard-bot: onboarding checklist created: 1) upload labeled PHI examples to secure bucket 2) HSM/KMS ticket opened (#SYN-602) 3) security review requested 4) capacity estimate pending 5) eval harness owner = Diego
Marco (CS): for eval metrics we want FN rate <0.2% for PHI on heldout, and redaction precision >98%. also request a regression test set from customer with edge cases (serials, timestamps, mixed free text).
Diego (Solutions): we'll own the eval harness and provide a script + CI job. plan: week0 = data ingest & access; week1 = redaction eval + tuning; week2 = perf + canary validation. target pilot start 2025-05-15 to meet go-live.
Asha (Runtime): I'll prototype perf numbers for our quantized 6B profile and share CPU/GPU memory/tps by EOD tomorrow. if we need A100s, lead time could affect timeline. recommend fallback option: a distilled 3B summarizer for UI calls to keep p95 low.
Priya (Security): also require customer to sign the dataplane addendum before preprod access. I'll draft and route for legal review.
Marco (CS): capturing renewal risk: marking account health = "at-risk-onboard" on dashboard and adding a weekly touchpoint with the AM and exec sponsor.
Lena (AE): great. I'll inform Synthex of the pilot plan and ask for the labeled dataset + confirmation on model variants and HSM preference. will update this thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
